name: codestar-notifications
description: This CodeStar Notifications API Reference provides descriptions and usage examples of the operations and data types for the CodeStar Notifications API.

subcommands.name: create-notification-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a notification rule for a resource.

subcommands.name: delete-notification-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes a notification rule for a resource.

subcommands.name: delete-target
subcommands.description: Deletes a specified target for notifications.

subcommands.name: describe-notification-rule
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specified notification rule.

subcommands.name: list-event-types
subcommands.description: Returns information about the event types available for configuring notifications.

subcommands.name: list-notification-rules
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the notification rules for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the tags associated with a notification rule.

subcommands.name: list-targets
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the notification rule targets for an Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: subscribe
subcommands.description: Creates an association between a notification rule and an Amazon Q Developer in chat applications topic or Amazon Q Developer in chat applications client so that the associated target can receive notifications when the events described in the rule are triggered.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a set of provided tags with a notification rule.

subcommands.name: unsubscribe
subcommands.description: Removes an association between a notification rule and an Amazon Q Developer in chat applications topic so that subscribers to that topic stop receiving notifications when the events described in the rule are triggered.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the association between one or more provided tags and a notification rule.

subcommands.name: update-notification-rule
subcommands.description: Updates a notification rule for a resource.
